name: 陳雅玫
objective: This course is designed for students who are curious about how artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming language learning and teaching. The course is organized around progressive microlearning tasks completed in small groups. Students will first explore and evaluate existing AI tools for language learning. They will then design AI-powered language learning activities, build simple AI conversation partners using role prompts, and finally create multimodal learning experiences that combine AI-generated text, images, audio, or video. Each task combines hands-on practice with critical reflection. Students will not only create learning materials with AI but also evaluate whether their work is accurate, inclusive, pedagogically appropriate, and ethically sound. Alongside these practical tasks, the course introduces key principles from language learning research to help students understand why certain AI-enhanced activities are effective and how they can be designed more thoughtfully. Students will examine how generative AI can support specific language skills, including vocabulary acquisition, grammar practice, speaking fluency, and writing development. By the end of the course, students will have gained hands-on experience with a range of AI tools, developed a portfolio of collaboratively designed language learning activities, and strengthened their critical awareness of how to use AI responsibly in diverse educational contexts.

Week 7:	Microlearning Task 1
Week 8:	How AI Supports Personalised Learning and & Self-Regulation
Week 9:	AI Chatbots & the Role of Interaction in Language Learning
Week 10: Custom GPT Design I
Week 11: Custom GPT Design II
Week 12: Microlearning Task 2
Week 13: Ethics & Responsible AI Use
Week 14: Microlearning Task 3
Week 15: Supporting Diverse Learners with AI
Week 16: Course Reflection

課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
remarks:
Weeks 17-18 Flexible Learning

Students will be asked to further improve the language learning tools or apps they created with AI during the course by applying what they have learned in class and incorporating peer and instructor feedback. They will submit the links to their improved AI tools or apps to the instructor by the end of Week 18. This improvement will account for 5% of the final grade.
